jobs.title: Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
WIR SIND WIETHE

Wiethe gehört zu den führenden Content-Produktionsunternehmen Europas und ist Marktführer in Deutschland. Für internationale Marken wie adidas, Y-3, Tchibo, C&A, FC Bayern München und Peek & Cloppenburg entwickeln und produzieren wir Content auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau.

Mit rund 250 Mitarbeitenden an unseren Standorten Bremen und Osnabrück produzieren wir jährlich über 5 Millionen Bilder, mehr als 20.000 Filme und mehrere Tausend AI Assets.

Unsere Kompetenz verbindet Fotografie, Film, Generative AI und CGI. Was uns besonders macht: Wir denken Content nicht in einzelnen Kampagnen, sondern in skalierbaren, technologisch gestützten Produktionsprozessen – mit höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität, Effizienz und Konsistenz.

Generative AI ist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Wachstumsstrategie. Wir investieren konsequent in neue Technologien, intelligente Workflows und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsmöglichkeiten.

Dafür suchen wir erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Teams führen, Kunden begeistern und unser weiteres Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten.

DEINE ROLLE

Als Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
übernimmst Du eine zentrale kreative Rolle in unserem wachsenden AI-Bereich.

Du verantwortest die kreative Entwicklung anspruchsvoller AI-Projekte für führende internationale Marken und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Ergebnis. Dabei verbindest Du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwelten mit fundierter praktischer Erfahrung im Umgang mit Generative AI.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung außergewöhnlicher visueller Konzepte, Bildwelten und kreativer AI-Lösungen, die Markenidentität, gestalterischen Anspruch und neue technologische Möglichkeiten miteinander verbinden.

Du bist kreative Instanz, fachlicher Lead, Sparringspartner unserer Kunden und Impulsgeber für die kreative Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Projekte.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Kreative Konzeption: Entwicklung und fachliche Führung innovativer GenAI-Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und unterschiedliche Content-Formate.
AI Art Direction: Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Look & Feel, Bildsprache, visuellen Systemen und kreativen Qualitätsstandards für AI-gestützte Produktionen.
Hands-on AI Creation: Eigenständiges Testen und Kombinieren generativer AI-Tools und Modelle sowie deren gezielter Einsatz in Bild- und Bewegtbildproduktionen.
Markenübersetzung: Übertragung von Markenidentitäten, Briefings und kreativen Leitideen in eigenständige, reproduzierbare GenAI-Ansätze und Bildwelten.
Kreative Projektführung: Fachliche Führung und kreative Weiterentwicklung der AI-Projekte gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Kreativ-Teams aus AI Artists, Art Direction, Design, CGI, Foto, Motion und weiteren Disziplinen.
Kreative Qualität: Sicherstellung einer durchgehend hohen gestalterischen Qualität, einer starken visuellen Idee und konsistenter Markenwirkung – auch über größere Asset-Mengen und Kampagnen hinweg.
Kundenverantwortung: Souveräne Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kunden auf Senior-Level – von der kreativen und strategischen Beratung bis zur Präsentation und Umsetzung.
Creative Technology: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Production und Technology, um kreative Ideen in technisch belastbare und wirtschaftlich realisierbare Produktionsansätze zu übersetzen.
Innovation und Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Identifikation neuer Modelle, kreativer Technologien und visueller Trends sowie deren Übersetzung in neue Bildsprachen, Formate und Content-Konzepte.
Wissenstransfer: Aufbau und Weitergabe kreativer Best Practices und Standards für den professionellen Einsatz von Generative AI.

UNSERE ERWARTUNGEN

Was Du Mitbringen Solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Direction, Design, visueller Kommunikation, Creative Technology oder vergleichbaren kreativen Disziplinen.
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit generativer AI in professionellen kreativen Projekten und Content-Produktionen.WIETHE CONTENT / CAREERS
Creative AI Lead
Ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür und einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Bildsprache, Komposition, Licht, Styling, Materialität und visuelle Qualität.
Ein überzeugendes Portfolio, das Deine kreative Handschrift, Dein Markenverständnis und den professionellen Einsatz generativer AI zeigt.
Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Konzeption und fachlichen Steuerung anspruchsvoller kreativer Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Beteiligten.
Die Fähigkeit, Markenanforderungen und kreative Briefings in eigenständige visuelle Konzepte und Bildwelten zu übersetzen.
Hands-on-Mentalität, Experimentierfreude und echte Begeisterung für neue kreative Technologien.
Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber anspruchsvollen Kunden sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsstärke.
Die Fähigkeit, kreative Entscheidungen klar zu treffen, zu begründen und innerhalb interdisziplinärer Projekte fachlich zu vertreten.
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
Bereitschaft zu regelmäßiger Präsenz an unserem Hauptstandort Bremen, da kreative Zusammenarbeit, Produktionen und Kundennähe wesentliche Bestandteile dieser Position sind.

Was Zusätzlich Von Vorteil Ist

Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Bild- und Videogenerierung, Image-to-Image, Style Development, Character Consistency oder vergleichbaren generativen Verfahren.
Erfahrung mit hybriden Foto-, CGI-, Motion-, VFX- oder AI-Workflows.
Erfahrung mit internationalen Marken und anspruchsvollen Kampagnenproduktionen.
Kenntnisse aus Fashion, Lifestyle, E-Commerce, Werbung oder der Agenturwelt.
Erfahrung mit Kundenworkshops, Pitches, Mentoring oder kreativer fachlicher Leitung interdisziplinärer Projektteams.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Eine zentrale kreative Lead-Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Kreation.
Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Handschrift unserer AI-Projekte maßgeblich mitzuprägen und neue Bildwelten für führende internationale Marken zu entwickeln.
Arbeiten in einem der größten und modernsten Content-Produktionsumfelder Europas – an der Schnittstelle von Generative AI, Fotografie, Film und CGI.
Modernste technologische Infrastruktur und die Freiheit, neue kreative Technologien nicht nur zu erproben, sondern in realen Produktionen einzusetzen.
Einen außergewöhnlich modernen, hochwertig gestalteten und bestens ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz mit einem inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld.
Ein erfahrenes, interdisziplinäres Team mit hoher Kompetenz in Kreation, Foto, Film, AI und CGI.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit einem begrenzten Homeoffice-Anteil, abgestimmt auf die Anforderungen der Rolle und die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort.
Langfristige Perspektiven in einem etablierten, wirtschaftlich starken und technologisch zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Corporate Benefits, Business Bike und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

READY TO SHAPE THE NEXT LEVEL OF AI CONTENT PRODUCTION?

Du möchtest Generative AI nicht nur anwenden, sondern neue visuelle Möglichkeiten erschließen, außergewöhnliche Markenwelten entwickeln und den kreativen Einsatz von AI auf das nächste Level bringen?

Du verbindest ästhetischen Anspruch mit technologischer Neugier und hast Lust, gemeinsam mit starken Teams neue Maßstäbe für AI-gestützte Kreation zu setzen?

Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Besonders interessant ist für uns Dein Portfolio mit ausgewählten Arbeiten, AI-Projekten, Kampagnen oder visuellen Experimenten, die Deine kreative Handschrift und Deinen Umgang mit Generative AI zeigen.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Founded in 2005, Hypebeast is a global contemporary-culture media brand with operations across 12 markets. Through original reporting, video, collaborations, and live events, Hypebeast covers fashion, footwear, art, design, music, sports, and technology, bringing audiences closer to the people and ideas shaping culture.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Producer to join our EMEA branded content production team in London. You will lead the production of a wide range of projects, including branded content, video campaigns, social media franchises, brand collaborations and experiential events.

The role covers Hypebeast and Hypebae branded content, Hypemaker white-label creative agency projects, and paid social media franchises across the wider portfolio, including Hypeform, Hypedrive, Hypetrak and HypeArt.

Reporting to the Executive Producer, you will manage multiple projects across EMEA, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget and to a high creative standard. You will work closely with internal teams, clients, talent and external suppliers, while contributing creative ideas, improving production processes and supporting junior team members.

Responsibilities:

Production and Creative Collaboration
Lead end-to-end production across branded content campaigns and paid social media franchises, from initial brief and creative development through to delivery and reconciliation.
Manage budgets, schedules, production plans, contracts, talent, crews, locations and external suppliers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Oversee productions on set and remotely, ensuring all assets meet the agreed creative brief, quality standards and delivery requirements.
Contribute creatively across projects by participating in brainstorms, helping develop concepts and creating storyboards and shot lists for social media franchises.
Work closely with Creative, Editorial and Sales teams to develop effective creative approaches that meet client objectives and audience needs.
Manage production documentation and administration in collaboration with the Production Coordinator, including contracts, invoices and supplier onboarding.
Work closely with Finance to monitor spend, manage reconciliations, ensure timely payments and flag potential budget or margin issues.
Maintain clear communication with internal teams, clients, talent and suppliers, proactively managing risks and resolving production challenges.
Support Sales and Creative with pitches, creative proposals, production approaches and budget estimates.
Build and maintain strong relationships with freelancers, production companies and external suppliers, negotiating competitive rates where possible.
Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, resource management and overall efficiency.

Experiential Production
Lead the production of branded events, activations and pop-ups, from initial planning and budgeting through to on-site delivery.
Manage event logistics, venues, suppliers, schedules and on-site teams across UK-based and international projects.
Work with internal and external teams to deliver experiences that meet the agreed creative vision, budget and client expectations.

Requirements:

Experience: 5+ years in content production, ideally within a media company, creative agency or branded content environment.
Creative thinking: Strong visual sensibility, with the ability to contribute ideas in brainstorms and develop concepts, storyboards and shot lists for social-first content.
Production expertise: Proven experience managing multiple projects, budgets, schedules, talent, crews and suppliers from brief to delivery.
Industry knowledge: Strong awareness of fashion, music, art and culture, with an understanding of the Hypebeast landscape and current creative trends.
Organisation: Excellent time management and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines and anticipate challenges.
Commercial awareness: Strong budgeting and negotiation skills, with an understanding of production costs, project margins and resource management.
Autonomy and leadership: Able to lead projects independently, make informed decisions, manage external teams and support junior producers.
Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders while maintaining positive working relationships.
Resourcefulness: Proactive and solutions-focused, with the ability to source resources efficiently and adapt to changing requirements.
Flexibility to travel: Willingness to travel within the UK and internationally, including at short notice, to support events, shoots and other production requirements.

If you think you’ve got what it takes, please provide your cover letter, CV and expected salary.

This position is based and located in London. Candidate must be eligible to work in UK.

Personal data collected is for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Creative Producer (all genders)

Full-time (40 hours/week) · Berlin · Hybrid (minimum 3 days/week in our Mitte studio)

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Creative Producer
who knows how to turn ambitious creative ideas into outstanding productions — balancing creative excellence, commercial responsibility and seamless execution.
You'll independently lead multiple productions across film, photography, social-first campaigns and brand activations for clients in fashion, lifestyle, sport and beauty. From evaluating briefs and developing production approaches to managing budgets, crews, clients and final delivery, you'll take ownership of making great work happen.
You'll bring strong creative judgement, a trusted network of collaborators and the confidence to make decisions when priorities shift. Working closely with our Creative, Social and Account teams, you'll help us deliver ambitious work with the craft, clarity and efficiency it deserves.

What You'll Do

Lead Productions from Brief to Delivery

Independently manage multiple productions, from initial brief evaluation and scoping through pre-production, shoot, post-production and final delivery.
Assess incoming briefs for creative feasibility, timing, resources and budget, and develop realistic production approaches.
Own project plans, schedules, logistics, resources, documentation and risk management, ensuring every stage runs smoothly.
Lead production meetings, align stakeholders and keep teams and clients informed with clear, proactive communication.
Anticipate challenges, make confident decisions and find practical solutions without compromising the quality of the work.

Enable Creative Excellence

Partner with Creative and Social teams early in the process to translate creative concepts into strong, achievable productions.
Bring creative judgement and production expertise to discussions around formats, talent, locations, technical approaches and execution.
Identify and engage the right directors, photographers, crew, creatives and production partners for each project.
Balance creative ambition with commercial and operational realities while protecting the original creative intent.
Take responsibility for production execution while working collaboratively with creative leads on the final output.

Own Budgets, Resources & Production Partners

Build, negotiate and manage production budgets, from initial estimates through cost tracking and final reconciliation.
Take commercial ownership of your productions, keeping scope, profitability, quality and client expectations aligned.
Plan and coordinate internal and external resources across overlapping projects.
Negotiate confidently with suppliers, talent, crews and production partners on rates, terms and deliverables.
Oversee relevant production requirements, including usage rights, licensing, insurance and permits.
Build and maintain a reliable network of production partners and freelance talent.

Drive Shoots & Post-Production

Take operational ownership on set, providing clear leadership to crews, suppliers and production stakeholders.
Keep shoots running to schedule while responding calmly and decisively to changing circumstances.
Coordinate post-production workflows, including feedback rounds, approvals, versioning, technical specifications and final delivery.
Work closely with creative leads and post-production partners to maintain quality throughout the process.
Ensure projects are properly wrapped, documented and handed over.

Strengthen How We Work

Work confidently within a fast-paced, multi-client agency environment, balancing several timelines and priorities.
Collaborate across Creative, Social, Account and Production teams to create clarity around responsibilities, decisions and deadlines.
Follow established agency processes, tools and approval workflows while identifying opportunities to make them more effective.
Share production expertise, support less experienced colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, solutions-focused team culture.

What You Bring

5+ years of relevant production experience, ideally within a creative agency or commercial production environment, with a proven track record of independently leading complex projects.
Strong experience across film, photography, social-first content and/or integrated campaigns, with an understanding of different production scales and formats.
Excellent project management and organisational skills, including the ability to oversee multiple productions simultaneously.
Commercial confidence in evaluating briefs, developing production approaches, managing budgets, negotiating costs and making sound decisions.
Strong creative judgement and the ability to turn ambitious concepts into achievable production plans.
Experience leading crews, managing external partners and working directly with clients and senior stakeholders.
An established network of creative talent, suppliers and production partners, with the curiosity to keep expanding it.
A structured, proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the confidence to take ownership and make decisions under pressure.
Clear communication skills, a collaborative mindset and the ability to bring different teams together around shared goals.
Confidence using project management, budgeting and production tools, and the flexibility to work within established agency systems and workflows.
Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken, with the confidence to communicate clearly and professionally with clients, creative teams and production partners.

How We Work

At HY.AM, great production is about more than delivering on time and on budget. It's about creating the conditions for strong creative ideas to become exceptional work.
We're looking for someone who takes pride in both the final result and the way we get there: someone who brings structure without slowing creativity down, takes responsibility without working in isolation, and knows when to challenge, collaborate or make the call.
You'll be part of an independent, social-first creative agency where production works hand in hand with creative thinking, and where your expertise will have a direct impact on the work we deliver.

What We Offer

Real Ownership: Lead ambitious productions from brief to delivery, with creative and commercial responsibility.

Interesting Brands:
Work across sport, fashion, lifestyle, beauty and culture.
A Team Around You:
Collaborate closely across Social, Strategy, Creative, Account and Production.
A Collaborative Production Team: Work closely with producers, art direction and post-production, sharing expertise and helping others grow.

Room to Grow:
Learning budget, industry resources and workshops.
Berlin Studio Culture:
A hybrid setup centred around our Mitte studio.
Benefits:
BVG support, Urban Sports Club, employee bonuses, working abroad, and other HY.AM benefits.
Beyond the Work:
Team dinners, activities, off-sites and everything that makes agency life more than deliverables.

Sounds Like You?

Creative-minded, commercially savvy and highly organised? We'd love to hear from you.
Send us your CV and a portfolio, showreel or examples of relevant productions you've led. Tell us what you owned from brief to delivery, and share one example of how you balanced creative ambition with budget, timelines or production challenges to make great work happen.
Apply via hiring-cp@hyam.de
.

We believe different experiences, perspectives and backgrounds make both our team and our work stronger. We encourage people of all genders, ethnicities, abilities and sexual orientations to apply.

Dich faszinieren Marketing

, Social Media
und Werbung
? Und du möchtest lernen, wie Creatives entstehen, die Millionen Menschen erreichen und messbare Umsätze erzielen? Dann könnte das dein Einstieg bei Pammys
sein.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über eine Million Kundinnen und Kunden
gewachsen und wurde von der Financial Times als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas ausgezeichnet.

Heute sind wir ein Team von über 150 Mitarbeitenden
mit Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel
und einem eigenen 22.000 m² großen Logistikzentrum in Lensahn
. Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir bauen eine globale Footwear-Brand und wollen in den kommenden Jahren auf einen mittleren neunstelligen Jahresumsatz wachsen.

Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, suchen wir einen Senior
Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
. In dieser Rolle lernst du von Grund auf, wie erfolgreiche Performance Creatives entwickelt werden – von der ersten Idee über UGC und Social Ads bis hin zur datengetriebenen Optimierung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Marketing-Experten zusammen und entwickelst Kampagnen, die nicht nur Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, sondern echten Geschäftserfolg schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Entwicklung von Werbekonzepten für Meta, TikTok und YouTube
Analyse von erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen, Trends und Wettbewerbern
Entwicklung neuer Hooks, Angles und Story-Ideen für Social Ads
Erstellung von Creative Briefings für Content Creator und UGC Creator
Recherche von Zielgruppen, Pain Points und Kaufmotiven
Auswertung von Creative-Tests gemeinsam mit dem Marketing-Team
Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung neuer Werbeformate und Kampagnen
Unterstützung bei internationalen Marketingkampagnen
Beobachtung aktueller Social-Media-Trends und Plattform-Updates
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Performance Marketing, Content und Brand Team

Dein Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Psychologie, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
Erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten, eigene Projekte oder Social-Media-Aktivitäten sind von Vorteil
Großes Interesse an Werbung, Social Media, E-Commerce und Konsumentenpsychologie
Du verstehst intuitiv, warum manche Inhalte viral gehen und andere ignoriert werden
Analytisches Denken und gleichzeitig ein gutes Gespür für kreative Inhalte
Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen, Daten und digitalen Tools
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Lust, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen
Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
Du möchtest in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld außergewöhnlich viel lernen

Echte Karriereperspektiven
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen
Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung
Eine Kultur, in der deine Meinung zählt und Wertschätzung gelebt wird
Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, keine endlosen Meetings
Moderne, zentrale Offices in Hamburg und Kiel
Dein Setup, deine Wahl – Laptop oder MacBook, dazu ein iPhone
Wellpass-Fitnesszuschuss für deinen Ausgleich
Kostenlose Getränke, Mitarbeitergutscheine & Corporate Benefits
Regelmäßige Teamevents, weil Erfolge gemeinsam besser schmecken

Pammys ist die am schnellsten wachsende Footwear Brand in Europa

A bit about Plntd

Plntd is a plant brand in Dubai. We sell mainly through our own site (Plntd.ae). We sell plants and
pots. The pots, we make inhouse.
Content is the front door of the brand. It’s how people find us on Instagram and it’s what feeds our
paid ads on Meta.
Right now almost every video we put out, I shoot, write and edit myself. That’s the bottleneck. This
role exists to remove it.

What the job actually is

You’d own our content output end to end.
Not scheduling posts. Owning the whole thing that turns an idea into a published video or an ad,
every week, without me in the loop for production.
In practice that means:

1. Pre-production

• Have a deep understanding of our visual direction and creative goals.
• Manage our idea bank (2–4 week content plan) based on these goals
• Plant for the shoots (with freelancers) to execute on these ideas: write the scripts and shot
lists. Every piece should adhere to our creative goals, and have a clear structure (hook, reason
to hold attention, etc).
• Plan to make the most out of the videographers’ days: i.e. getting as much Broll as possible to
fill our content bank.
• Coordinate with Lana to make sure shots we need for ads are worked into production as well.

2. Production: getting it made

• Brief and direct freelance videographers on shoot days, roughly one a week or one a fortnight
• Plan shoot days so we get a lot out of them. Several scripted pieces plus a growing library of B-
roll each time. This can also include BTS shots
• Shoot simple things yourself on a phone/camera when a full shoot day isn’t worth it.
• Keep the footage library organised so clips are easy to find and reuse in the future.

3. Editing and shipping

• Edit all our organic reels. Target is 3 a week. CapCut, Premiere is okay. Ideally, DaVinci.
• Viedographers are expected to do edits based on their shots, but we canalso need to do
editing on top of that, in hour, to make use of our library.
• Cut ad variations from the same footage (different hooks, lengths, formats) and hand them to
Lana on a schedule
• Make sure everything looks and sounds like Plntd. Captions, music, tone
• Publish and schedule, write the captions and on-screen text

4. Analytics/looking at the numbers

• Sit with me once a week and go through retention on what we shipped. Hook rate, hold rate,
where people drop
• Use that to decide what we do more of and what we stop

What I’d hope to see in the first 90 days

• 3 organic reels a week, consistently, made without me beyond the weekly review
• A steady flow of ad variations going to Lana every week
• A tagged, reusable B-roll library building up from each shoot day
• A written-down content system. Idea bank, plan, brief, shoot, edit, publish, review

The experience I think it needs

• 3+ years making short-form video for a brand, a creator or an agency, where you owned the
result and not just the execution
• Editing experience in at least one proper tool. Fast, clean, comfortable with vertical, captions,
sound and pacing. This is learneable.
• You can write hooks and scripts, and you can walk me through why they worked
• You’ve briefed and directed a shoot before, even if someone else held the camera
• You understand what a paid media person needs from you and why
• You read the analytics and change what you do because of them

Nice to have

• You’ve built a content process at a small brand rather than inherited one
• You actually like plants, interiors or home. Not a requirement, but it helps
• Basic camera and lighting

What this role isn’t

• A social media coordinator who schedules posts and replies to comments. Community
management isn’t this
• A pure editor waiting for footage and a brief
• A videographer who needs someone else to decide what to shoot

The Head of Brand Growth owns how Wego wins travellers before they search, and makes that growth measurable. You will own the Wego brand, social, and our creator and influencer programme, with your own budget and your own numbers. Brand growth strategy

Job Description

About BYD

Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature.
We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team.

BYD is a leading, high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operates in four core fields of IT, automotive, new energy, and rail transit and employs over 300,000 people worldwide. As a global pioneer in New Energy Solutions BYD is dedicated to building a zero-emission ecosystem.

Position:
Senior Creative Designer & Content Producer – Middle East

Location:
Dubai, UAE

Reports to:
Marketing & PR Director – Americas, Europe & MEA

Who We Are

BYD Group is a leading global high-tech company with businesses spanning automotive, electronics, new energy and rail transit.

As BYD continues its rapid expansion across the Middle East, we are strengthening the regional presence of our multi-brand portfolio – BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG – each with its own distinctive positioning, visual identity and customer experience.

Your Mission

We are looking for a highly creative, versatile and hands-on Senior Creative Designer & Content Producer based in Dubai to support the growing creative needs of BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG across the Middle East.

This is a hands-on creative production role, not a coordination-only position. The successful candidate must be able to personally turn briefs into high-quality creative outputs – from graphic design and presentation design to on-site content shooting, video editing and event recap videos.

You will support creative requests initiated by BYD’s regional and internal teams, working closely with HQ, regional Marketing & PR teams and local importer/dealer teams to understand market context, gather local inputs and ensure smooth execution.

While close collaboration with importers and dealers is essential due to the region’s business model, this role primarily serves BYD’s internal regional creative and communication needs, ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG.

What You’ll Be Doing

Creative Design & Execution: Independently create high-quality visual assets for regional marketing and communication needs, including key visuals, event materials, digital and social content, invitations, posters, internal communications and other creative deliverables.
Multi-Brand Creative Support: Develop and adapt creative materials across BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG, understanding the distinct positioning and visual language of each brand and ensuring the right level of differentiation.
Video Shooting & Content Capture: Personally shoot photo and video content when required, particularly during vehicle launches, motor shows, media events, VIP activities and other key regional moments.
Video Editing & Post-Production: Independently edit short-form videos, event highlight videos, recap videos, internal summary videos and other fast-turnaround content for regional communication needs.
Event Creative Support: Work closely with the regional Events and Marketing teams to support major vehicle launches, motor shows and brand events with creative materials before, during and after the event.
Presentation Design: Create and enhance professional PowerPoint presentations, transforming business content, strategies, reports and proposals into visually compelling, executive-level presentations.
Localization & Adaptation: Adapt global and HQ creative assets for Middle East markets while maintaining brand consistency and taking into account local cultural, language and market requirements.
Importer & Dealer Collaboration: Work closely with local importer and dealer marketing teams to obtain local information, assets and execution requirements, while ensuring that regional creative outputs remain aligned with BYD’s internal briefs and brand standards.
Fast-Turnaround Creative Support: Respond efficiently to urgent regional creative requests and be comfortable producing high-quality work under tight timelines, especially around product launches, executive visits and major events.
Brand Governance: Ensure all creative outputs strictly follow the respective brand guidelines of BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG, including typography, logo usage, visual identity, imagery and overall brand tone.
Creative Asset Management: Maintain organized regional creative assets, templates, source files, photography and video libraries to improve efficiency and consistency across future projects.

Key Results

Deliver high-quality creative materials for BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG efficiently and consistently across Middle East regional projects.
Provide strong in-house, hands-on creative capability, reducing dependency on external agencies for day-to-day and fast-turnaround creative requirements.
Produce high-quality photo and video content from major vehicle launches, motor shows, events and executive activities.
Deliver timely and engaging event recap and highlight videos following major regional activities.
Improve the visual quality and professionalism of regional presentations, reports and executive-level materials.
Maintain strong and consistent brand identity across all regional creative outputs.
Establish an efficient working relationship with regional teams, HQ and local importer/dealer marketing teams.

What You Bring

5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, creative production, visual communication or a related creative role.
A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent graphic design and visual communication skills across both digital and offline formats.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
Strong video editing capabilities, with proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional editing software.
Practical ability to shoot photo and video content independently, with a good understanding of composition, lighting, framing and storytelling.
Ability to independently create polished short-form videos, event highlight videos and recap content from raw footage.
Strong PowerPoint / presentation design skills, with the ability to transform complex business information into clear, visually compelling executive presentations.
Strong understanding of brand identity systems and the ability to work across multiple brands with different visual languages and positioning.
Automotive, technology, premium/luxury or lifestyle brand experience is highly desirable.
Experience working in the Middle East and/or with importer/distributor/dealer organizations is preferred.
Highly hands-on, proactive and comfortable personally executing creative work from brief to final delivery.
Ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Willingness to travel across the Middle East when required for major launches, events, content shoots and other key activities.
